dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    gdb \
    lldb \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes Python bindings for gdb and lldb matching the detected imports. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, installs system packages for gdb and lldb (since Python bindings require the underlying tools), copies requirements, installs Python dependencies, and sets a default command. Adjust 'your_script.py' to match your actual entry point.
